title: Harbor District Reopens After Two-Year Renovation
author: Staff Reporter
summary: Shops, a public promenade and a restored ferry landing welcomed their first visitors this week, closing out one of the city's longest-running construction projects.

title: Regional Transit Board Approves Weekend Service Expansion
author: Staff Reporter
summary: More frequent buses and two added late-night routes will begin next spring after the board's unanimous vote.

title: Local Bakeries Report Record Holiday Orders
author: Staff Reporter
summary: Pre-orders for pies, breads and cookies are running well ahead of last year, and some shops have already stopped accepting new requests.

title: Opinion: Why Public Libraries Still Matter
author: Guest Columnist
summary: In an age of endless digital content, the library remains one of the few places open to everyone, for free.

title: High School Robotics Team Heads to State Finals
author: Staff Reporter
summary: After a strong regional showing, the students will compete against the top teams in the state next month.
